title: Conditional kappa 0.00308326 (+1.37e-6 over #5580): compensated shared P104 relay
body:
Two owned P104 deliveries can be replaced by a shared dirty public relay. Explicit invertible input preconditioning and late full-frame cleanup preserve every arbitrary input. Removing an unused intermediate frame on public field 148 gives local paid delta `H6-H1-H2-H3`, with unchanged productive targets, eight owned lifetimes and owned peak one.

The complete certificate supports **conditional kappa 0.00308326**, a gain of **0.00000137 over #5580**. Its raw crossing lies in (0.00308326461942, 0.00308326461943). The bill has 66,816 paid jobs, 12,814 productive targets and 25,167 local events. The selected frontier is untouched.

Concurrent #5565 (0.00308520) and #5599 (0.00309839) have stronger claimed endpoints. This PR isolates a different mechanism and does **not** claim the best pending endpoint. Composition requires a separately checked combined word and invoice.
